title: Show HN: Stop applying to jobs using AI-generated resume
author: grandimam

excerpt: When LLMs hands you a resume or pdf it carry markers of how it was made, including the source. You can't see them on the page but applicant tracking systems can read it. So recruiters are flagging such profiles and rejecting them entirely. I had tested this across 40+ AI models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, etc) to produce a resume and every single file carried a marker. To solve this problem. I had built a free tool to show what your file says and gives you a cleaned version: - Drop your resume and get a cleaned copy - Free, no account. What it doesn't do: it won't rewrite your resume or make AI-sounding wording more human. It only deals with what's hidden in the file. It's a simple tool, but it feels absolutely necessary now as more people are using AI for generating their entire resume or even editing them. I am the developer, happy to answer any questions.
